decision.limitation: Four alternating comparisons cover only eight exposed chronological edits with provisioned banks. Query caps bound specific counters, not total runtime or process memory. Whole-cofactor preparation/checking and the opposite branch remain.
decision.next_target: Investigate the interaction structure of guards with more than one unfixed assumption: group by exact current support/component, identify overlapping and complementary regions, and distinguish compact reusable closure from regions still requiring acquisition. Keep local certificate reuse optional until fresh end-to-end evidence repays matching/preparation.
decision.result: Transport checked conditional unit traces under further assignments into an actual local cofactor. Surviving support containment, exact coordinate bindings and native proof checking are required. Same guided probe selection and observed ordered search path.
decision.scope: Preserve all regressions, alternate proofs and unresolved roots. Automatic origin discovery, general coordinate transport, fresh unlabelled evaluation and unrestricted resource bounds remain open.

limitations: Incremental cumulative audit: every old six-table payload is byte-identical; new nodes and dependencies replay through both readers. Earlier complete-history and 342-partition checks remain hash-bound, not rerun.

Both readers fully check one database per target/arm. Four repetitions and separate traced reruns have identical six-table payloads, native/guard/certificate counters and binary archive hashes within each arm. Both arms have identical ordered visit/expansion/probe/choice digests.

Every transported unit trace passes existing native checks on the actual cofactor. The transformer is tested exhaustively on two-variable formulas and further restrictions, plus small random truth cases, missing component support and invalid evidence. No new Lean refinement proof.

All inputs are exposed and banks provisioned. Probe selection and observed path remain fixed in this experiment; a local reuse gain does not solve the opposite branch or give uniformly cheap arbitrary SAT expansion.

All eight exposed edits and causal source banks are fixed. Four alternating serial repetitions restore the prefix immediately after each origin. No later repeats, union history or posthoc census bank seeds search.

Both arms use the frozen guided selector. Certificate transport is attempted only after a checked cache miss, before full-cofactor unit propagation. It uses existing native unit publication and original recomposition; no new proof authority.

Exact local containment is required for every surviving support clause. Already fixed trace steps are skipped; an opposite fixed step yields an earlier conflict. Failure or budget exhaustion falls back to the unchanged lazy probe.

Setup charges bank loading/copying. Solve charges validation, coordinate tracking, matching, local support maps, trace transport, publication and fallback. Initial source acquisition/extraction remains additional.

Complete-worker timing includes restoration, setup, retained-graph accounting, new-node warm replay, full native cold replay, result serialization and compression. Imports, frozen-source hashing and case loading are outside it.
Separate traced reruns record an ordered digest of native visits, expansions, probe inputs and guard choices, outside timed comparisons; they must reproduce untraced counters and payloads.

Counters bound candidate checks and reserved support literals only, not bank validation, whole-cofactor position construction, guard pairs, trace steps or total memory. Checked-cache/bank bytes and peak process RSS are reported separately.
All prior payloads and alternate valid certificates are preserved. Local refutation reuse does not establish broader root coverage or polynomial unrestricted expansion.
